# Synthetic fatsecret protocol fixtures

**SYNTHETIC.** These files copy the *shape* documented at https://platform.fatsecret.com/docs/v2/image.recognition (checked 2026-10-02): field names, nesting, and numbers sent as strings. Every name and number is made up for arithmetic and error-path tests. They are **not** fatsecret responses, and no live response is ever stored as a fixture (pending-rights policy).

`barcode_found.json` copies the shape documented at https://platform.fatsecret.com/docs/v2/food.find_id_for_barcode (checked 2026-10-13), with the same made-up values.
